hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Singleton launch hook for the LaunchFactory supporting four launch modes (Beam, Prism, Flare, Dawn). Trading fees are split between a platform treasury, creator, and community; Flare pools accumulate fees for a permissioned buyback-and-burn to a dead address. Only the locker may add liquidity, and Dawn mode applies a 99% fade fee that decays 1% per second down to the resting rate.
